description: Changes the business context. Named fields replace what is there and cost nothing. rules replaces the brand's design rules, which every picture writer follows above any brief. words keeps the owner's own words about the brand whole; they outrank everything else and every film director reads them. rebuild true rewrites every field from the owner's words (the ones given now, else the ones on file) and everything Marsell knows: one model call, about 1,200 tokens; use it when the owner pastes their brief or says the context is wrong about the brand. It needs an act key.

aesthetics.description: aesthetics by their common names; replaces the list

avoid.description: what never to show or say; replaces the list

imagery.description: how pictures of this business look: photographs, illustration, screens

owner_words.description: The owner's own words, exactly as they said them: what an argument ending in _from_message keeps.

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.

rebuild.description: true rewrites every field from the owner's words and everything Marsell knows (one model call, spends tokens); fields named beside it win over what it writes

rules.description: the brand's design rules, one each, as the owner or their guide states them; replaces the rules (business_context_read designRules) and keeps the owner's other words as they are

summary.description: the design language in plain sentences; replaces what is there

words.description: the owner's own words about the brand, exactly as they wrote them, never a summary

words_from_message.description: true when the owner's words are the message they just sent: it is kept exactly as sent, so you never retype it

name: business_context_change
title: Business context change
